HelpText:
Click the pencil to record a bind. Hold your combo (Ctrl, Alt and/or Shift plus one more key), then click the check to save it or press Esc to cancel. The trash icon removes a bind.

A red border means the same combo is bound twice. Neither one will fire until you fix that, and it turns red as soon as you hold a combo that's already taken, even before you save it.

Binds work whenever the game has focus, even if this window is closed. They don't block the keypress, so if the game already uses that combo, both will trigger.
